items.title: Commission proposes Quantum Act and new Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to strengthen Europe's industrial capacity and security
items.description: Commission proposes Quantum Act and new Sovereign Tech Equity Fund to strengthen Europe's industrial capacity and security Anonymous (not verified) Wed, 11/25/2026 - 08:52 The European Commission today proposed the Quantum Act, a new framework to help turn Europe's quantum research into products and services, strengthen supply chains and prepare Europe's digital systems for post-quantum cryptography. GettyImages © AliseFox The proposal also lays the groundwork for the Sovereign Tech Equity Fund (STEF). The impact of quantum technologies will be profound, from navigation without satellites and faster drug discovery to ultra-advanced batteries and next-generation secure communications. Quantum technologies are moving from laboratories to products and services. The Quantum Act has three main pillars: research excellence, bringing quantum technology into use, and keeping systems and supplies
